results.pair_summary: Doc B defines the canonical Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) interface for llama.cpp integration, specifying pointer-based types and event structures required by the Delta3 Kernel. Doc A provides a deterministic mock implementation of this exact interface using symbolic types for testing purposes. They share identical API signatures to ensure ABI compatibility.
results.integration_rationale: Doc B serves as the production contract (PhysicalLayer HAL) for native code interaction, while Doc A is critical for unit testing and simulation of the Delta3 Kernel without external dependencies. The 'mock_compat' invariant in Doc B explicitly mandates their coexistence to ensure the kernel logic remains decoupled from the underlying C library implementation details.
